name: Tokikuni Sora
source:
Sora tries to avoid large crowds because of her ability to "hear the universe". With her sharp hearing, she usually knows anything that happens throughout the school. She does rituals together with the [url=/c98544]Futaba[/url] [url=/c98545]twins[/url] in the Occult Research Club, and the three also often try to raise funds for the club.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
